root.label: Air Alert app launched after 2022 invasion

events.label: Air Alert app launched after 2022 invasion

slots.name: app build duration
slots.sentence: For instance, the widely used “Air Alert” app was built in just 72 hours following the 2022 invasion by a private IT company seeking a more efficient warning system than traditional sirens.

slots.name: setup time
slots.sentence: Within three days, the developers secured a technical partner and arranged real-time data sharing with the Ministry of Defense.
